caption: The drawing depicts a single large, circular object that resembles a golden or bronze hoop or earring, set within a simple rectangular border on a plain background. The main object is rendered in shades of gold and yellow, with brown detailing accentuating its contours and giving the appearance of a metallic sheen. The lower part of the hoop has a wavy, irregular edge with a textured pattern along the inside, while the upper portions are smooth and rounded. The ends of the hoop terminate in round, thicker segments, with one end having a looped design and the other ending in a solid round nub. There are also two smaller black line sketches on the drawing: one in the top right corner and another in the bottom left corner. These sketches show simplified, partial outlines of the hoop and its construction, focusing on the joint or hinge mechanisms. The overall composition centers the colored hoop in the middle, with minimal additional elements or background details.
title: Loop Earring
